name: zeni-wallet-monorepo
description: Zeni — The Post-Quantum Smart Wallet for QoreChain

scripts.zip:ext: pnpm --filter @zeni/core build && pnpm --filter @zeni/extension build && cd apps/extension/dist && zip -r ../../../zeni-wallet-extension.zip . && cd ../../..
scripts.build:connect: pnpm --filter @zeni/connect-protocol build && pnpm --filter @zeni/connect build && pnpm --filter @zeni/react build && pnpm --filter @zeni/connect-demo build
scripts.test:connect: pnpm --filter @zeni/core test && pnpm --filter @zeni/connect-protocol build && pnpm --filter @zeni/connect build && pnpm --filter @zeni/relay test && pnpm --filter @zeni/connect test
